title: Earthy Crispy Mexican Egg Plants Chilaquiles
description: A buttery and crisp Mexican dish featuring egg plants and bonito flakes, inspired by the Chiapan region, this low-calorie-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight breakfast or snack. It combines the earthy flavors of egg plants with the smokiness of bonito flakes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the egg plant slices with 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter until they are evenly coated.
Spread the egg plant slices on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
In a large skillet, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the diced red onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the corn tortilla squares to the skillet and cook until they are crispy and golden brown, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the baked egg plant slices, crispy tortilla squares, bonito flakes, chopped cilantro, and lime juice.
Season the mixture with salt to taste.
Serve the Earthy Crispy Mexican Egg Plants Chilaquiles hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
